originating_goal: Activate the completed StegGate/AdmittedCode SDK fallback correction for users without granting GitHub Actions or non-TV/TVC credentials release authority.
trigger: canonical main contains a completed release-worthy SDK correction that is not yet present in an observable published release/package
deterministic_inputs: latest published release tag and target SHA
required_outputs: release tag whose source contains the required correction head or its canonical successor
published release/package whose contents include the permanent sovereign fallback and canonical result-alias correction
package verification receipt proving those files/behaviors are present
completion_condition: A TV/TVC-authorized release/package is observable, its source contains the required correction commit(s), the distributed package is verified to contain the corrected fallback/adapter/CLI surfaces, and the task records COMPLETE evidence.
blocked_condition: TV/TVC release authorization or sovereign release executor is unavailable.
blocked_release_condition: Machine-observable TV/TVC release authorization/executor becomes available.
retry_condition: An authorized release is initiated but release/package observability or package verification is not yet complete.
review_required_condition: Canonical main advances after the registered required head; recompute the release candidate so no later required SDK correction is omitted.
failed_condition: Published release/tag/package evidence is inconsistent or does not contain the required correction; fail closed and do not represent the SDK fix as user-activated.
collision_boundaries: Do not grant GitHub Actions tag, release, push, PyPI, or credential authority.
Do not use GitHub token as runtime or production release authority.

Do not overwrite a newer canonical SDK release task without reconciling its evidence.
Do not represent source-on-main as distributed user activation.
